pages.en:
Extract from French Report (Part 2) of December 10, 1932
D4314

Arrival of A.A. Vinokouroff

We learn that one A.A. Vinokouroff arrived in Shanghai
on the 2nd instant on board the s.s. Hoten Maru. Up to Dec.6
he has been residing at the Astor House and on December 7 he
removed to The Park Apartments, 455 Rue Lafayette.

It is understood that this individual has come to
Shanghai to represent certain German firms, the names of which
we have not yet learned. Recently he has paid several visits
to the offices of the local branch of Centrosojus and to the
ADH 311 German firm "Wostwag", strongly suspected of handling the
finances of the IIIrd International (vide our report of Dec.8
1932, p.1., para.1)

Vinokouroff, it appears, was at one time in the employ
of "Arcos", a "private" Soviet firm with offices in London.

Note that several years ago the Police in London raided
the premises of the firm, when many compromising documents
were seized.

Arrest of an escaped Communist

Towards 3.15 p.m. on December 9 information was received
that a notorious communist had just escaped from the 2nd District
prison and had been met with in the road.

The staff of the Investigation Dept. immediately set out
in pursuit and arrested the prisoner on the corner of Avenue
Joffre and Rue Marco Polo. It was Yu Zeng Han (    ) alias
Hu Hai, who had been arrested at 10 p.m. July 12, 1932 at the
Tsung Die Societe des Beaux Arts, 4 Fong Yu Li, Rue Chapel,
a communist organisation, and sentenced on Aug.16 to 3 years and
6 months imprisonment by the 3rd Branch Kiangsu High Court (vide
our report of Aug.16, 1932 p.18, para.10). While being detained
while awaiting decision to intervene.
pages.zh:
1932年12月10日法国报告摘录（第二部分）
D4314

A.A. Vinokouroff 抵沪

据悉，A.A. Vinokouroff 于本月2日乘“Hoten Maru”号轮船抵达上海。截至12月6日，他一直居住在礼查饭店（Astor House），并于12月7日搬至拉斐德路455号公园公寓（The Park Apartments）。

据了解，此人来沪是为了代表某些德国公司，其名称我们尚未获悉。近期，他多次前往当地 Centrosojus 分支机构的办公室，以及 ADH 311 德国公司“Wostwag”，后者被强烈怀疑为第三国际处理财务事宜（参见我方1932年12月8日报告，第1页，第1段）。

Vinokouroff 似乎曾受雇于“Arcos”，这是一家在伦敦设有办事处的苏联“私营”公司。

请注意，数年前，伦敦警方突袭了该公司的场所，查获了许多令人难堪的文件。

一名在逃共产党人被捕

12月9日下午3时15分左右，接获情报称，一名臭名昭著的共产党人刚从第二区监狱逃脱，并在路上被人发现。

调查科人员立即出发追捕，并在霞飞路与马科波罗路转角处逮捕了该囚犯。此人是余增汉（音译），化名胡海，曾于1932年7月12日晚10时在霞飞路丰裕里4号宗迭美术社（Tsung Die Societe des Beaux Arts，一个共产党组织）被捕，并于8月16日被江苏高等法院第三分院判处三年六个月监禁（参见我方1932年8月16日报告，第18页，第10段）。在被拘留等待干预决定期间。

Subject (in full) A.A. Vinokuroff former Soviet Employee.

Made by D.J. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

A.A. Vinokuroff arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on
November 2, 1932 by the s.s. "Hoten Maru". It is reported
that he was employed several years ago with "Arcos" (Soviet
Commercial Establishment) in London. He is a Russian 63
years of age. Upon his arrival he resided at the Astor House
Hotel. Recently moved to Park Apartments 485 Rue Lafayette.

[签名: GTcheremshansky]

Special Branch S.2.
January 16, 1933.

Memorandum on the movements of V.K. Koodrevatoff,
Soviet Employee

Vladimir Kuzmitch Koodrevatoff, who arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin on December 7, 1932, returned to
Harbin via Dairen on January 10, 1933 by s.s. "Dairen
Maru". He is an employee of the Chinese Eastern
Railway and is reported to be connected with the
Russian Communist circles.

When in Shanghai he resided at the "Imperial
Hotel", 941 Bubbling Well Road.

Gtcheremshansky.
D. S.
16/1/33

Officer i/c Special Branch
Information.

关于苏联雇员 V.K. Koodrevatoff 行踪的备忘录

Vladimir Kuzmitch Koodrevatoff 于1932年12月7日从哈尔滨抵达上海，于1933年1月10日乘“Dairen Maru”号轮船经大连返回哈尔滨。他是中东铁路的雇员，据报与俄国共产党圈子有联系。

在上海期间，他居住在静安寺路941号帝国饭店（Imperial Hotel）。
